name: At-home hair dyeing and color transformations
what_it_is: Videos show people mixing and applying hair dye themselves at home — box dye, cartridges, or custom shades — often as before-and-after transformations, unboxings, and tutorials. Some feature product demos (Zuvi coloring device, L'Oréal Excellence Nudes) and salon/stylist tips, but the shared subject is DIY hair coloring rather than a single triggering moment.
